QUOTE: "In `sanitizeReactions`, this returns early with `deleteReactions: []`, so a single add event never deletes other reactions on the post. Without it, the function would diff the full DB set against the incoming list and mark anything missing for deletion."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that skipSync stops the single incoming reaction from being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post.
